capabilities: fetch WikiDocs books into the vault
edit book documents locally with image drag-and-drop and folder-based table-of-contents editing
upload completed documents back to WikiDocs with a send-to-WikiDocs command
disambiguation: Not a general wiki-note tool; it manages content on the WikiDocs publishing service.
extras: README is written in Korean and only covers installation and initial setup; guides for writing books and blogs are referenced as separate documents.
problem: Writing and editing WikiDocs books normally happens in the web editor, which is slower and unavailable offline compared to working in local files.

relations.evidence: 위키독스 책과 블로그를 더 효율적으로 작성하고 편집할 수 있게 해주는 도구

requires.name: WikiDocs API token (Base URL and token entered in settings)

summary: Integration for the WikiDocs service that fetches, edits, and uploads WikiDocs books and blog posts from inside Obsidian.
